name: claude-cli
description: Use the official Claude Code CLI from Codex for scoped reviews and file edits.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate reviews and file edits to Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: A community Codex plugin using the authenticated official Claude Code CLI. Codex scopes the work, Claude reviews or edits files, and Codex verifies the result.
interface.defaultPrompt: Ask Claude to review my current changes.
